set system host-name SSH-Server.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login user client001 class re.template: set system login user [parameter1] class [parameter2] authentication plain-text-password [parameter3]
set system login user client001 class re.command: set system login user client001 class read-only authentication plain-text-password "@%@%UyQs4,KTtSwJo(4QmW#K,LC:@%@%"
set system login user client001 class re.explanation: 配置系统登录用户，指定用户类别及认证方式。

set system login user client002 class su.template: set system login user [parameter1] class [parameter2] authentication plain-text-password [parameter3]
set system login user client002 class su.command: set system login user client002 class super-user authentication plain-text-password "@%@%UyQs4,KTtSwJo(4QmW#K,LC:@%@%"
set system login user client002 class su.explanation: 配置系统登录用户，指定用户类别及认证方式。

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Configure the protocol version used for SSH services.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.explanation: SSH protocol version, v2 indicates use of SSH version 2.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.1/16.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
